requestSnapshot.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: native game-art patch p01_02.
Edit IMAGE 1 only. Return exactly ONE opaque square PNG, native 1254 x 1254 pixels, with IDENTICAL framing and geometry. This is subtle material continuity correction of a tiny extreme-close crop, not a new scene.
Image 1 contains the exact neighboring top 230 pixel band. Image 2 shows that native top band separately as the shape/color anchor. Image 3 is the left native 230 pixel overlap. The last three images are approved whole-city layout, stone material and Daoist style references only; never copy their composition.
Fix only discontinuous warm/cool stone shading and overly cellular or marbled texture in image 1 interior. Stone color must continue naturally from the authentic top band and left overlap. Broad smooth pale grey / soft grey-beige planes, very faint brush texture. No polygon patches of different colors, flakes, dense scales or heavy veins. Preserve the existing light and shadow shapes.
LOCK the entire top band y=0..229 exactly as image 1 / image 2. LOCK the bottom band y=1024..1253 exactly as image 1 because it is connected to another patch. LOCK left x=0..229 except corners follow image 1. Make interior transitions into fixed bands natural, with no straight, wavy or polygonal tone seams. The crop contains ONLY broad nearly horizontal stone stairs. Preserve every tread, riser, highlight and grout edge in its original position. No vertical joints or added slabs.
Do not alter leaves, red/gold elements, joints, shadows, stair count, perspective, size, cropping or layout. Do not add objects, symbols, text, buildings, landscape, stairs, vertical grout or UI. No zoom out. Only subtle stone continuity correction; preserve all other pixels. Output native 1254 x 1254.
